title: Signal assertion does not distinguish file access from content
root_cause: The test reports only that isReady returned false. The masked runtime path might be unreadable or absent, or the file might be readable but contain a value rejected by the code; the available evidence does not distinguish those causes.

relevant_evidence.why: The test reports a boolean assertion failure without an underlying file error.
Both a failed read and a non-ready value return false.
The test reads the runtime path and asserts the combined result.
The path comes from a secret whose value is unavailable.
